Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the father-in-law as Ngwane III by incorrectly inferring that Sobhuza I (Ngwane IV)’s father was his numeric predecessor. This confused regnal numbering/succession with direct paternity, ignoring the reliable sources shown (e.g., Wikipedia) that state Sobhuza I’s father is Ndvungunye (Zikodze).
